title: Northern Honduras: banana companies, the Garífuna and Berta Cáceres
goal: Report what people said and cite sources about the banana strike, the Garífuna and Berta Cáceres, with dijo que and según.
grammar: reported statements and sources: dijo que, según (review)

sections.title: Northern Honduras: banana companies, the Garífuna and Berta Cáceres
body: In this lesson you read about the north of Honduras: the banana companies, the Garífuna people and the Lenca leader Berta Cáceres. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for reporting what someone said and for naming a source: *dijo que* and *según*.

items: I can report what people said, with *dijo que* and the right past tense.
I can name my source with *según*.
I can tell the story of the 1954 banana strike and of Berta Cáceres in a few sentences.
